commit.message:
feat(post): work offsets ride the stream as a 1-based index; the post writes the word

PARAM WorkOffset now carries the setup's 1-based offset number. A script
that declares workOffsetIndex = true receives the number and states
workOffsetMax (6 when unstated); the engine refuses a higher offset by
setup name. An unflagged script receives G54..G59 for offsets 1-6 exactly
as before and is refused any offset above 6. Legacy G54..G59 words in a
stream read as 1-6; any other value is refused by setup name.

All 11 shipped scripts declare the flag, their maximum and a
workOffsetName(n) and map the index themselves (no slotOf / frameOf word
parsing left). Tormach mill and lathe take offsets 7-9 as G59.1-G59.3
(LinuxCNC G-code reference); every other dialect declares 6 until its
extended words are verified against a public manual. The docs state the
1-based WorkOffset beside the probe's 0-based SetWorkOffset.

Slice 1 of 3; goldens byte-identical.

Refs #931

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CUsqDAgjpiZbXSvmXLvdmL

feat(app): work offsets post as an index bounded by the setup's own post

Slice 2 of #931. The stream carries the setup's 1-based offset index
(Dump::wcs is a u32; posting::wcs_context returns the index). The
six-offset cap leaves core: SetSetupWorkOffset checks the pick against
the setup's own post, a new verification clause
(setup_offsets::range_problems) refuses by setup name an offset the
setup's post cannot express, and the loader keeps only the u8 sanity
bound. A stored offset is never read as offset 1 anywhere - not in
setup::work_offset, wcs_context, the label or the setup sheet.

setup::work_offset_names reads the post's name table (cached per post
and script text) for labels, the setup sheet and refusal texts; display
only. Offsets 1-6 still save as G54..G59 (byte-identical files); 7+
save as their number, which older builds cannot open. WCS_SLOTS becomes
the crate-private legacy entity-name list.

Refs #931

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CUsqDAgjpiZbXSvmXLvdmL

feat(ui,mcp): work offsets listed by the setup's post; MCP takes an index

The Setups page combo lists offsets 1..=max of the setup's own post,
worded "Work offset n (NAME)" ("Work offset n" when the post names
none); a stored pick beyond the post's range stays visible as itself
and says so. The heights hint and the combo's hover no longer name a
fixed G54-G59 range.

MCP set_work_offset takes a 1-based index (G54-G59 as aliases of 1-6;
word kept as the older spelling), refused by setup name through the
command's own post check. Replies, set_wcs and get_job carry index and
name, with word kept as an alias of name. camcraft-mcp skill updated;
PROCESS_VERSION 21.

Slice 3 of 3, stacked on #1113.
